versions.content: channelSynchronousWakeup is set to FALSE and at least one explicitWakeupChannel reference If CommunicationConnec- tor.createEcuWakeupSource is set to TRUE, EcuInstance.channelSyn- chronousWakeup is set to FALSE and at least one CommunicationConnector. explicitWakeupChannel reference is defined, then a dedicated wakeup source for this CommunicationConnector is derived and that wakeup source wakes exactly those PhysicalChannel s that are referenced by CommunicationConnector.ex- plicitWakeupChannel . The CommunicationConnector is assigned to this wakeup source.
